quests.title: Friends... In the Aquarium?

dialogue.t: Hey, Columbina! Are you admiring the fish in our aquarium?
Mmhmm. You've done an amazing job with this place. There are so many fish I've never even seen before.
Have you been to an aquarium before?
No, though I saw a few fish tanks in Snezhnaya. But my eyes weren't truly open back then, so I never really appreciated things properly.
It's beautiful. I never knew the underwater world was so vibrant and colorful. It's like... living in eternal springtime.
Oh, look at that fish. Don't you think it looks just like Sandrone? And those two over there, one following behind the other... They're like the two of you!
Hey, you're right! Now that you mention it, they really do look like us.
That busy-looking one over there reminds me of Lauma. And that one in the coral seems to be quietly observing everything, just like Lady Nefer.
Uhm... Paimon gets the feeling you like matching all your friends to fish...
Not exactly. I like my friends, so I naturally find myself thinking about them. Even when I'm looking at fish.
Wow! Paimon's really happy to hear you say that! So, are there any other fish that remind you of someone?
Hmm... I've made a lot of new friends lately. I'm afraid I can't find a fish to match every single one of them.
That makes sense. Anyway, we'll keep adding more fishies to the aquarium! You should come back from time to time — maybe you'll be able to find even more of your friends next time you're here!
...You're going to put my friends in the aquarium?
Of course not! Paimon's talking about fishie lookalike friends, you big silly!

quests.description: Columbina seems to be admiring the aquarium…
